q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

The file `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` contains all memo CRUD mutations and queries (`useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, `useMemo`, `useMemos`, etc.). It imports `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect` (`web/src/connect.ts:197`), which is a generated Connect-RPC client created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` wrapping the `MemoService` service definition.
